title: London extension costs and planning approvals
description: Typical all-in costs of rear extensions, side-return extensions and loft conversions in each of the 32 London boroughs, and each borough's householder planning decisions over the last 90 days (decided, approved, approval rate, typical wait), from Cost My Extension (https://costmyextension.co.uk). The cost figures are estimates for a typical house, including VAT and fees, not quotes. The planning figures are derived from the Planning London Datahub (Greater London Authority). Each release is a monthly snapshot.
